description: Get the solver's oracle USD prices per (chain, token). For quoting with sodax_get_solver_quote, filter chainId='146': chainId-146 addresses pass the quote service's compatibility check, while spoke-chain (non-146) addresses are rejected with 'not compatible with the quote service'. Caveat: passing that check (being listed/priced) does NOT guarantee a swap route — canonical bridged *_ASSET hub tokens and major stablecoins route most reliably, while many wrapped/derivative/money-market entries (e.g. WBTC, waLocBTC, SONIC_SODA_ASSET) are priced but frequently return 'No path was found', and routability is pair/amount/liquidity-dependent. Also useful for sanity-checking quote amounts against the USD prices the solver uses.

chainId.description: Filter results to a single intent-relay chain ID (decimal string, e.g. '146' for Sonic). Call sodax_get_relay_chain_id_map to translate.

format.description: Response format: 'json' for raw data or 'markdown' for formatted text

symbol.description: Filter by token symbol (case-insensitive exact match, e.g. 'SODA', 'bnUSD')

name: sodax_get_solver_oracle
